contexts.text: Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth () = three kinds of doctrines. AC 600. AC 617. AC 1065.
Shem, Ham, and Japheth, when named, = the man of the Church; but when called sons = truths of faith, (or doctrinals). AC 768, Explained. AC 769.
All these Churches, called Shem, Ham, and Japheth, together constitute the Ancient Church.
(In the Ancient Church) Shem = internal worship. AC 1140.
Shem = the internal Church. Explained... In every Church there are internal men... who make charity the principal... These, in the Ancient Church, were called Shem. AC 1083, Explained.
Shem and Japheth took a garment... () = that the internal Church, and the corresponding external one, interpreted for good. Explained.
Shem is named first (because) charity is the first of the Church.
Blessed be Jehovah the God of Shem () = all good for those who worship the Lord from internal things.
Shem = the internal Church, which is so called from charity, in which the Lord is present.
Shem = the man of the internal Church. Described. AC 1100:end.
He shall dwell in the tents of Shem () = that the internals of worship be in the externals.
Shem = the internal Church, or internal worship.
When I spoke with those called Shem, they inflowed softly through the region of the head into the region of the breast towards the heart, but not to the heart. SE 4106.
On internal worship, which is Shem, and its extension even to the second Ancient Church. Treated of.
Those called sons of Shem were internal men, and worshipped the Lord, and loved the neighbour. Their Church was almost such as is our true Christian Church.
Shem = true internal worship.
Shem () = the Ancient Church in general, because he here regards Eber. AC 1221.
Born to Shem () = that a new Church came forth from the Ancient Church.
The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram (). Shem = an internal Church; the sons of Shem = the things which are of wisdom. Enumerated. AC 1224. AC 1232.
These are the sons of Shem () = derivations from internal worship.
These are the nativities of Shem () = the derivations of the second Ancient Church.
The nativities of this Church are derived from Shem, because Shem = internal worship; here, the internal worship of this Church, which was different from that signified by Shem before. AC 1336.
The Ancient Church acknowledged the Lord, and called Him Jehovah, especially those who had internal worship, and were called sons of Shem.
Those of the Church called Noah were distinguished as to goods and truths into three classes, which were named Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
Shem and Japheth () = those of the Spiritual Church who have received the truths of faith in good, which is charity.
The continuation of the Ancient Church, called Shem...
Mentioned.
Shem = the inmost, or celestial Church (in every Church).
